stories.title: Transformers Releases: Release v5.24.0
stories.summary: # Release v5.24.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling 2 Mini Inkling 2 Mini is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that takes text and images as input and generates text. It is based on Inkling 2 Small, but has 24 decoder layers instead of 48. To make up for the smaller depth, layers 6 to 17 are looped three times, and a learned message-passing mechanism mixes the residuals of the previous pass into the attention and MoE inputs of each loop layer.
